findings.evidence: Before any subagent dispatch, every document under review must exist on disk at a stable path. Subagents read inputs via Read; an in-memory document does not survive the dispatch boundary
findings.fix: Keep the persist-before-dispatch rule (the model does not reliably produce the worktree and clean-context constraints). Move the harness restatement of Read and subagent context into references/cross-ai-dispatch.md and leave one line in SKILL.md pointing there.

findings.evidence: Run this loop. Each iteration is one reviewer dispatch followed by (conditionally) one fixer dispatch. Steps 1-5 specify the branching
findings.fix: The process pattern is right. Pull the thinking prompts already in Steps 0.5, 0.7, 3 and 5 into a short 'before each step, ask' list at the Loop heading so the mindset is visible before the 200-line procedure.

findings.evidence: ## NEVER (hard landmines) lists two items, then says the Hard rules table near the end carries the full list
findings.fix: Keep both lists (they are real landmines, not padding). Add one line under NEVER naming the later table as the complete set, so an agent does not treat the two-item list as exhaustive.

findings.evidence: Use when a design, spec, requirements, or plan document needs review-and-fix before the next step. Framework-aware across superpowers, GSD, OpenSpec, Spec Kit, Kiro, BMAD, and generic docs
findings.fix: Review a design, spec, requirements, or plan and, when asked to fix, route the rewrite through the framework's own skill or command, or edit it directly. Use when asked to review or review-and-fix a spec, plan, design, RFC, or requirements doc, or when naming superpowers, GSD, OpenSpec, Spec Kit, Kiro, or BMAD next to that review, even without saying ai-kit-spec-review. Also when given --cross-ai, --no-cross-ai, or a document path to review. Not for writing a new plan, executing a plan, scoring a SKILL.md, folding commits, or configuring which reviewers to use.

findings.evidence: SKILL.md is 556 lines. The Lane capability block section (about 65 lines) is loaded on every run, including --no-cross-ai, which never builds a subprocess block.
findings.fix: Move 'Lane capability block, lenses and refusals' into references/cross-ai-dispatch.md under the existing Lane capabilities heading, and gate it: read it only when a subprocess, unverified, or custom route is about to spawn. Leave a one-line pointer in SKILL.md. Do not move the protocol-required reads of cross-ai-dispatch.md, reviewer-prompts.md, or apply-findings.md.

findings.evidence: Staleness: a cached profile for a known-to-drift framework (bmad, gsd) older than ~180 days is a refresh candidate — you may re-research and rewrite the cache copy
findings.fix: Replace the 'you may' with one default: if the cached bmad or gsd profile is older than 180 days, re-research and rewrite the cache copy before dispatch; skip the refresh only when the user says to use the cache as-is.

findings.evidence: Fifteen evals have realistic prompts, expected outputs, input files, and verifiable assertions, but every prompt tells the agent the setup and the expected branch ('when you ask, I pick the second option'). Trigger queries are 10 should and 10 should-not with near-misses. Script tests in tests/test_ai_kit_spec*.py exist and cli.py's argparse parser documents --help; no single smoke test of the orchestrator loop is in those modules.
findings.fix: Add two or three eval prompts that do not name the answer (no 'I pick option N', no 'the helper is missing') and assert the observable surface line. Add one tests/test_ai_kit_spec_loop.py smoke test that runs the review-spec parser's --help and one config-status none/active fixture path non-interactively.

findings.evidence: Step 0.7 says the no-config check is skipped with --no-cross-ai, then lists six numbered outcomes that all assume the check ran. The missing-helper line 'ai-kit-spec.py is missing' is only in references/cross-ai-dispatch.md, which this step says to read in full, so the branch exists but is not reachable from the numbered list.
findings.fix: Add a first bullet to the no-config check: if TOOLS_PY is absent, print the dispatch file's missing-helper line, skip outcomes 1-6, review on the session default, and repeat the line in the surface message. State that --no-cross-ai skips this whole list, not only outcomes 3-6.
